protocol.k_definition: unique target prompts with at least one action label; the dense safety prompts are included in k
protocol.safety_gate: deploy Router iff there are at least 50 untouched target safety prompts and the paired bootstrap 95% CI lower endpoint of Router-static-LP on them is > 0
protocol.alpha_selection: internal 20% split within each action's fit labels, followed by fixed-alpha refit on all fit labels
protocol.sparse_rule: n_fit(a)=max(20, round(fit_cap*min(1,4.7/cost(a)))), capped by fit_cap; safety labels remain dense
protocol.source_reuse: uniform mean of four n=300 source residual experts, per-action target location/slope calibration, fixed 25% blend
protocol.source_training_cost_treatment: sunk/reusable; not charged to target incremental cost

image_seed_audit.reason: UniGen pool scores and CoreBench Flux4B pool scores do not provide a uniform per-image-seed decomposition across A7; a five-benchmark paired 1/3/5 comparison would change the data support and is therefore not identifiable from current files
